description_en: Queries the list of domain names for API security detection
description_zh: 查询API安全检测的域名列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-matched-hosts --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-x0r37plpl0g --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApisecMatchedHosts

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name or IP address
parameters.name: matched_host

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The detection type. Valid values:
api: the domain name list of API assets.
abnormal: the domain name list of risks.
event: the domain name list of security events
parameters.help_zh:
检测类型。取值：
api：表示API资产的域名列表。
abnormal：表示风险的域名列表。
event：表示安全事件的域名列表
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

MatchedHost.description_en: The domain name or IP address

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
